title: RETREAT_FACE_ON: while retreating under fire, keep the torso and guns on the nearest shooter (return fire) without changing the retreat path/legs
source: Diego's P-D-024 death study (PR #152 comment; F15 in PR #175, Uncertain) and the Coordinator brief 2026-11-22 01:25 AM ET
mechanism_choice: Fallback mechanism, not Diego's proposal verbatim. Diego's RETREAT_FACE_ON (#152: 'when retreating and exactly 1 enemy with a laser sees us -> keep facing it and firing while backing off (strafe-retreat) instead of turning away') is not a single change on P48: it changes the legs (backing off instead of P48's walk to building/tree cover) as well as the torso, and its trigger (exactly 1 laser seer) targets the vs-champions cause, not the house-bot cause (retreat with 2+ gun seers, 37%, 40-120 s). So P57 changes only the torso/aim target during the champion's retreat.
hypothesis: P48 dies mostly while retreating (60-67% of deaths, F15), most often to 2+ gun-armed house bots watching at 40-120 s. In the retreat the champion's torso stays on its Build 16 kill-value lock, which is often not the enemy shooting at us (or has no clear line), so we take fire without returning it. Turning the torso and guns onto the nearest enemy that is shooting at us and that we can hit returns fire while the legs still run to cover, so shooters break off or die and fewer retreats end in death.
mechanism: In the champion's three retreat branches (mode 'retreat to cover', 'retreat, trees', 'retreat': HP < retreatHp, hit in the last 2 s, not engaging, in zone), from t >= 40 s, never in a drop run or ring hold and never while a drop is near AND reachable within DROP_RUN_M (the P48 drop test): pick the nearest enemy mech among the target options that has a clear line from our muzzle, is inside the reach of a weapon we hold (gun, laser or lightning), and sees us or hit us in the last 2 s; make it the aim/fire target for this decision. The champion's weapon choice, aim, lead and fire gates then run unchanged on it. The target lock state, move, boost, path and every other mode are unchanged.
activation: Decision-level: in a retreat mode at t >= 40 s, no drop run/hold/near-reachable drop, a shooter in reach exists, and it is not the champion's chosen target. Game-level Step A count = games where this happens at least once.
disproof: If Step A < 10/192 on either set, or practice shows deaths <40 s up on either base, or retreat deaths not down on at least one base, or the mean lower on both bases, stop with outcome C/D and no PR.
positives: Round 1 kept deaths <40 s, pins and 20 s pauses identical (gate at t >= 40 s and the drop gate held: 0 activations before 40 s, no new pins). Step A confirmed F15 on the house screen: 136/190 and 124/189 champion deaths happen in a retreat mode (72% / 66%).
negatives: Taking fire off the champion's kill-value lock during a retreat costs kills: seeds 44 (1st survivor -> 11th, died 115 s) and 6035 (death 201 s -> 117 s) both lost a lock that was clear, in range and about to die (the champion killed it 1-2 s later) because P57 turned onto a nearer shooter. Kills 293->279 and 358->352, retreat deaths 57->60 and 60->62.
confidence: Disproven (for torso/aim changes during the P48 retreat: the champion already shoots a shootable enemy whenever one exists, and switching to the nearest shooter is worse)
reuse: Don't retarget during retreats. In P48 the torso is never idle while a shot exists (Build 16 interim role), so 'return fire while retreating' is already done; the 60-70% retreat-death share has to be attacked through the legs (where/when to retreat, e.g. EARLY_RETREAT_HIDE_ON) or by not entering the retreat, not through aim. Retreat deaths as a pre-registered metric: defined as death with last decision mode starting 'retreat'.
